blocks.text: Setting up the Canva desktop app on your Mac

The web version is fine, but the dedicated Mac app is better for deep work. It keeps your design workspace separate from your browser tabs. Download it from the official site. Once installed, drag it to your Dock for quick access. This prevents you from losing your design in a sea of open browser windows.
Keyboard shortcuts for faster lesson creation

Speed is vital when you have a deadline for a new curriculum unit. Use these shortcuts to work faster. Press T to add a text box. Press R to add a rectangle. Press C to add a circle. Press L to add a line. Press ⌘ + G to group selected elements. Press ⌘ + D to duplicate anything you have selected. These simple commands save seconds on every single element. Over a long document, these seconds turn into hours saved.
Managing complex layouts with the layers panel

Curriculum materials often involve many overlapping images, text boxes, and shapes. Do not struggle to click the right item. Go to the Position menu in the top toolbar. Click the Layers tab. This shows you every element on your canvas in a list. You can drag items up or down to change their order. You can also lock elements here to prevent accidental movement while you work on other parts of the design.
If you struggle to select a hidden element, use the Layers panel in the Position menu. It is much more reliable than clicking around the canvas.
blocks.title: Stop clicking blindly

blocks.text: Consistency makes your curriculum look professional. Use the Brand Kit feature to save your school or district colors and fonts. When you start a new worksheet, these colors appear first in the color picker. This removes the need to manually enter hex codes every time you design a new handout.
How to handle large document files

Large design files can slow down your Mac. If you notice lag, avoid putting everything in one massive file. Split your curriculum by module or week. Use the Canva folder structure to keep these files together. If the app feels sluggish, force quit the app with ⌥ ⌘ ⎋ and restart it. This clears the temporary cache and usually restores performance.
Exporting your materials for print or digital

When your design is ready, you need to share it. Click Share in the top right corner. Choose Download. For printing, select PDF Print. Ensure you check the Crop marks and bleed box if you are sending this to a professional printer. For digital distribution, standard PDF is fine. It keeps the file size smaller for easier email attachments.

faq.question: Does the Canva Mac app work offline?
faq.answer: The Canva desktop app requires an active internet connection to load your designs and assets. It does not support offline editing.

faq.question: Can I use custom fonts in Canva?
faq.answer: Yes. If you have a Pro account, you can upload your own fonts in the Brand Kit section on the left sidebar.

faq.question: How do I fix a frozen design?
faq.answer: Try refreshing the page with ⌘ + R. If that fails, force quit the app using ⌥ ⌘ ⎋ and launch it again.
